note: One entry per use case the watcher follows. 'query' and 'more' are Europe PMC searches and 'arxiv' are arXiv API searches (both public, no key); arXiv is what alphaXiv mirrors. 'laws' are the checks a paper's numbers can be put through; each names the general theorem it is an instance of. A check can only say 'inside the bound' or 'outside the bound' for the numbers extracted. It never certifies a paper.

bilayer_plate_ceiling.says: A two-layer sheet cannot curl tighter than 2.25 x (swelling difference) / (total thickness).

inputs.deps: difference in free swelling strain between the layers (a fraction, not percent)

bilayer_plate_ceiling.kind: proved bound under stated assumptions (Timoshenko bilayer, Poisson ratio up to 0.5)

bilayer_strip_ceiling.says: A narrow two-layer strip cannot curl tighter than 1.5 x (swelling difference) / (total thickness).
bilayer_strip_ceiling.kind: proved bound under stated assumptions (narrow strip)

strouhal_band.says: Cruising swimmers beat their tails so that frequency x amplitude / speed falls between 0.2 and 0.4.
strouhal_band.kind: empirical band, not a proved law; the Lean file proves only how the band follows from the frequency-speed line

low_reynolds.says: A swimmer this small and slow is in the viscous regime: density x speed x size / viscosity is below 1.
low_reynolds.kind: regime check in water (kinematic viscosity 1e-6 m2/s), integer arithmetic

clock_wavefront.says: Somite length equals wavefront speed x clock period.
clock_wavefront.kind: model identity, tested here within a factor of 1.5; the tolerance is our convention

crosslink_direction.says: More crosslinker: stiffer, and less swelling.

inputs.series: dose-ordered values of modulus or swelling from one figure or table

crosslink_direction.kind: direction only, checked by a script, no Lean instance
